title: Anti-Slip Rug Pads 24-Pack – Keeps The Rug In Place
descriptionHtml:
Stop slipping on the rug

Rugs that slide around are both annoying and dangerous. They wrinkle, bunch up and can make someone trip.

Stick it down and forget it

These self-adhesive pads attach under the rug and hold it firmly in place. They are reusable and can be washed when they need freshening up.

Features

  • Holds the rug firmly in place
  • Self-adhesive and reusable
  • Washable – gets the grip back
  • Good for rugs, cushions and mattresses
  • 24 pads in the package

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
